generator.program.note: The zamias' own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the palm base: it gives the values its species leave unset, as Cycadaceae's program does.

traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Gymnosperms (DELTA, 2008 onwards, version of 5 August 2019), Zamiaceae: the leaflets have many parallel or wavy veins and no midrib (Stangeria aside).
